placeName.zh-CN: 美国科罗拉多州西尔弗顿

note.zh-CN: 2026 顺时针：Animas Forks 补给站从镇址移回 Grouse Gulch，去掉 CR 9 环线，赛道缩短 0.64 mi；Virginius Pass/Governor Basin 下坡因矿场修复有一处绕行，约 0.6 mi 后回到原线。
note.en: 2026 clockwise: the Animas Forks station moved from the townsite back to Grouse Gulch, the CR 9 loop was removed and the course shortened 0.64 mi; a mine-remediation detour on the Virginius Pass/Governor Basin descent rejoins the original route after about 0.6 mi.

details.direction: Silverton loop; clockwise in 2026, counter-clockwise in 2027
details.distanceMethod: Official 2026 course page and runners manual: 101.8 miles (about 163.8 km). The homepage calls it a 100-mile run and the 2025 manual says approximately 102.5 miles; this card uses the 2026 figure.
details.elevationMethod: Official 2026 course page and runners manual: 33,441 ft climb (about 10,193 m). The 2025 manual says roughly 33,197 ft; the 2026 aid-station segments sum to 33,440 ft. This card uses the 2026 official total.
